At a maximum-modulus vertex, undirected nonnegative Laplacian coupling cannot increase the modulus, so upper Dini M'<=-(alpha-beta c_R)M. Synchrony z_i=iR gives outward motion at negative delta and nonzero equilibria at delta=0. With delta>0 the analytic f' satisfies Re f'<=-alpha+beta+beta c_R² M(t)²; the Laplacian Poincare inequality integrates to ||Pz(t)||<=exp[beta tan²R(1-e^{-2delta t})/(2delta)]e^{-(alpha-beta+kappa lambda2)t}||Pz(0)||. A small Fiedler-vector perturbation has a nonzero limiting rescaled projection by an integrable cubic forcing, certifying uniform exponent sharpness. Euclidean-to-Kobayashi comparison on |z|<=R gives the pairwise metric bound. No claim extends beyond this polydisc.
